instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph of two female friends posing together. On the left, the woman in the blue-and-white striped off-the-shoulder top (R2) stands in profile facing right, smiling warmly at the camera with her right hand resting on her friend's shoulder. On the right, the woman in the distressed denim jacket (R1) stands facing slightly left, leaning her head gently against her friend's head and smiling brightly with her teeth showing. The shot is a medium shot at eye level, captured against a solid, vibrant red background. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting that highlights the blue and denim tones of their clothing, creating a cheerful and friendly mood.
elements: R2 rests her right hand on R1's shoulder
R1 leans her head gently against R2's head
R2 is in profile while making shoulder contact with R1
R1 smiles brightly with teeth showing while leaning toward R2
The portrait is set against a solid vibrant red studio background
